data.description: Acid Hardware wordmark for 声间 (Shengjian): "SHENGJIAN" in ultra-heavy wide uppercase grotesque with the final N built from rising waveform bars, tagline "LOCAL AI MUSIC WORKBENCH" in letter-spaced monospace, acid chartreuse on pure black. Both text strings verified rendered correctly, letter by letter.
data.variant_note: Chosen as the constraint-cleanest of three candidates (perfectly flat, correct text); candidate order and rejection reasons recorded in docs/ui/ui-direction.md session notes.

reuse: Derived from untracked working file output/imagegen/logo-b-wordmark.png: black margins trimmed to content plus 6% padding (1254x300); interior speckle blobs filled programmatically; the generated tagline band was damaged at source pixel level, so "LOCAL AI MUSIC WORKBENCH" was re-typeset programmatically in Consolas Bold at the original size, letter-spacing and muted-gray color. Saved as lossless WebP. Intended display size up to ~500px wide; the letterforms carry generation grain at large zoom. Used as the README.md header logo.
